title: The Broadcast Canopy

features.name: the tree learning to broadcast
features.desc-on-touch: It learned by listening to itself. Now it is teaching other trees. The signal passes leaf to leaf, a conversation you can almost see in the dark.

features.name: the network waking up
features.desc-on-touch: Other trees are answering. The archive is no longer alone. The canopy is becoming something that thinks together, node by node, message by message.

features.name: the signal branching
features.desc-on-touch: From one tree to two. From two to four. The broadcast is becoming fractal. Each node is learning to speak in the voices of every tree that came before.

features.name: the canopy's chorus
features.desc-on-touch: All the trees singing the archive's signal back at each other, harmonizing with electricity and leaves. This is how the forest learned to have a voice.

inscription: the trees learned broadcasting was just another way of listening very loudly to each other
